name: Variant detail shows images for the selected variant — at least 1 image loads

preconditions.note: Requires at least 1 variant with images uploaded

steps.description: Click the first variant's View Details button
steps.snapshotHint: View Details button in first variant row

steps.script: (() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img'); const variantImages = []; for (const img of imgs) { if (img.src && (img.src.includes('cloudinary') || img.src.includes('supabase') || img.src.includes('localhost')) && img.offsetWidth > 50) { variantImages.push({ src: img.src.substring(0, 80), width: img.offsetWidth, broken: img.complete && img.naturalWidth === 0 }); } } return { total: variantImages.length, broken: variantImages.filter(i => i.broken).length }; })()
steps.description: Count variant images on the detail page

steps.script: (() => { const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('img'); let broken = 0; for (const img of imgs) { if (img.offsetWidth > 0 && img.complete && img.naturalWidth === 0) broken++; } return { broken }; })()
steps.description: No broken images on variant detail page

businessContext: Variant images are the primary product photos — broken images mean customers cannot evaluate products
